rationale: This is a randomized, double-blind interventional trial with an explicit placebo comparator arm. The record says participants are compared to a matching nasal spray with no medicine in it, and one arm is labeled Placebo. The placebo is used only during the first 12 weeks; after that, continuing participants receive foralumab.
